pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed VR/treadmill behavioral training with a familiar-novel context-switch paradigm, run via the behaviorMate/VRMate system

parameters.reward_shaping: random locations reduced to 1-2 fixed zones once criterion (>=60 VR laps or >=30 TM laps) was met
parameters.context_switch_vr: single session, switch to novel context after 30 familiar laps, >=30 more novel laps

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trained mice performing context-switch VR/treadmill navigation

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of dorsal CA1 during behaviorMate-controlled VR/treadmill sessions

parameters.objective: 16x Nikon water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3 mm WD

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon GCaMP8m time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium signal preprocessing: motion correction, ROI/neuropil extraction, and DeltaF/F calculation

parameters.motion_correction_roi: Suite2p for motion correction, signal/neuropil extraction, ROI detection
parameters.curation: manual curation via Suite2p GUI to exclude non-somatic ROIs

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, neuropil-corrected DeltaF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Event binarization via OASIS deconvolution and shuffle-based place-cell/spatial-tuning classification

parameters.place_field_criteria: 3-25 consecutive significant bins (12-100 cm), event detected in >=50% of trials

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: binarized event trains, tuning curves, and place-cell classification

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-day ROI registration (CellReg) and rate-map/remapping correlation analysis between familiar and novel contexts

parameters.registration: spatial mask correlation across days for treadmill sessions, manually curated in Suite2p GUI
parameters.correlation: Pearson correlation between average familiar/novel tuning curves
parameters.tm_shift_correction: circular shift maximizing population vector correlation applied uniformly to novel-context ROIs

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-day registered ROIs and remapping/rate-map correlation values

pipeline_steps.technique: Naive Bayesian decoding of animal position from population calcium activity

parameters.model: naive Bayesian classifier, per-frame per-spatial-bin posterior
parameters.cross_validation: trained on n-1 trials, tested on held-out trial
parameters.roi_matching: 500 randomly selected ROIs, decoding accuracy computed over 50 iterations

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded position and decoding accuracy vs. chance

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection and chronic hippocampal CA1 imaging window/headpost implantation in VGAT-Cre mice

parameters.coordinates: AP 2.25 mm, ML 1.45 mm, DV -1.55 to -1.05 mm, 100 nl/site, 100 um steps
parameters.cannula: 1.7 mm cannula with 1.7 mm glass coverslip

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: GCaMP8s-expressing GABAergic CA1 interneurons with chronic imaging access

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed virtual-reality spatial navigation training with a familiar-novel context-switch paradigm

parameters.reward_shaping: 25 random rewards progressively reduced to 2 fixed reward zones, criterion 100 laps/30 min
parameters.context_switch: familiar vs. novel environment blocks, switched every 10 laps for 60 laps total
parameters.sessions: two sessions per animal (stratum oriens, stratum pyramidale), each with a distinct novel context, >=3 days apart

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trained mice performing context-switch VR navigation

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo multiplane two-photon calcium imaging of CA1 interneurons

parameters.objective: 16x Nikon water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3 mm WD
parameters.multiplane: piezo objective scanner, ~30 um plane spacing, ~6 Hz/plane

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw multiplane two-photon GCaMP8s time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium imaging preprocessing: motion correction, ROI detection/curation, and DeltaF/F calculation

parameters.roi_curation: manual curation via Cellpose2 and Suite2p GUI
parameters.baseline: 7th percentile of neuropil-corrected signal over the full recording

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, curated DeltaF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Ridge-regression removal of velocity-related activity from neuropil-corrected calcium signals

parameters.model: ridge regression of velocity against neuropil-corrected signal
parameters.downstream_use: velocity-regressed DeltaF/F used for all analyses except velocity-modulation analysis itself

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: velocity-regressed DeltaF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Calculation of physiological tuning features: velocity modulation, context-mean activity, spatial rate maps, rate-map correlation/split-half reliability, sparsity, and reward selectivity/modulation indices

parameters.velocity_modulation: Pearson correlation between running velocity and max-normalized DeltaF/F
parameters.rate_maps: 5 cm spatial bins, Gaussian smoothing SD=10 cm
parameters.sparsity: spatial sparsity formula over rate-map bins
parameters.reward_selectivity: normalized difference in pre-reward-zone activity between the two reward zones

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: velocity-regressed DeltaF/F traces with position/context labels
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell physiological feature set

pipeline_steps.technique: Generalized linear model PCA (GLM-PCA) of the cell-by-gene expression matrix to derive a transcriptomic axis (tPC2)

parameters.input: raw integer gene-count matrix, 610 cells x 500 genes
parameters.component_selection: second principal component (tPC2) identified as major transcriptomic continuum axis

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell tPC2 transcriptomic score

pipeline_steps.technique: Random-forest classification of interneuron subclass from physiological features, with leave-one-animal-out cross-validation and balanced bagging

parameters.classes: Pvalb, Sst, Lamp5, Vip/Chrm2 (merged due to low n)
parameters.ensemble: 500 bagged random forests, balanced downsampling per iteration, 600 trees, max depth 10, min leaf size 5

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: predicted interneuron subclass and classification accuracy metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: High-resolution in vivo two-photon z-stack acquisition for cross-modal cell registration
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: composite in vivo structural z-stack

pipeline_steps.technique: Perfusion and cryoprotection/tissue processing for downstream MERFISH sectioning

parameters.embedding: OCT, frozen in prechilled 2-methylbutane, stored at -80C

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cryoprotected, OCT-embedded brain tissue

pipeline_steps.technique: MERFISH spatial transcriptomics experiment on fixed-frozen sections with GFP co-immunostaining

parameters.immunostaining: anti-GFP (rat, Abcam ab255886; chicken, Abcam ab300644)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: MERFISH spatial transcriptomic images

pipeline_steps.technique: MERSCOPE image segmentation using custom-trained Cellpose2 models

parameters.models: PolyT+cell-boundary model and DAPI-only model, trained on manually segmented image snippets

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: segmented cell masks

pipeline_steps.technique: Semi-automated cross-modal 3D registration pipeline aligning in vivo functional imaging, ex vivo section imaging, and MERSCOPE data into a common coordinate frame

parameters.in_vivo_stitching: custom MATLAB code, x/y/z stitching of 4 overlapping FOVs with sharpening and z-scoring
parameters.registration_steps: iterative common-cell selection, scaling, affine, and deformable transformation between MERSCOPE-ex vivo and ex vivo-in vivo pairs

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: in vivo z-stack, ex vivo section images, MERSCOPE images
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: co-registered 3D volumes across imaging modalities

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-modal cell matching linking in vivo functional imaging masks to MERSCOPE cell identities via ex vivo intermediate registration and IoU-based overlap matching

parameters.matching_criterion: IoU > 0.25, minimum centroid distance for best match

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: CSV table linking in vivo cell IDs to MERSCOPE entity IDs

pipeline_steps.technique: MERFISH data quality control: transcript/gene count filtering, blank-probe contamination filtering, volume filtering, normalization, and doublet detection

parameters.doublet_detection: Scrublet on raw counts, up to 20 PCs, score cutoff 0.25

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: QC-filtered cell-by-gene matrix

pipeline_steps.technique: Unbiased hierarchical cell-type clustering and subtype assignment from MERSCOPE transcriptomic profiles

parameters.preprocessing: per-cell normalization, log-transform, scaling, PCA (top 20 PCs), kNN graph (k=10)
parameters.resolution_selection: stability analysis across 30-50 seeds, resolutions 0.1-1.0, silhouette score and adjusted Rand index
parameters.clustering: Leiden algorithm, 3 hierarchical levels (class, subclass, type)
parameters.annotation: manual annotation referencing published hippocampal IN atlases, yielding 14 molecularly distinct IN types

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: hierarchical cell-class/subclass/type taxonomy with marker genes
